title: LA GALERÍA
comment: GALERIA, 2026-11-08. Forked from salon.json. The mansion's long portrait gallery seen straight down its length: tall arched windows full of moonlight on the left wall, gilt-framed portraits under small warm picture lights on the right wall, white marble statues on plinths standing against both walls between them, a long carpet runner down the far half of the hall, and tall double doors at the far end, the way out. The near floor is open polished marble for footwork. Ids reused from the shared set: window = moonlit windows, glass = portraits, pilaster = statues on plinths, stage = the carpet runner, door = far doors.
scene: It is the mansion's long portrait gallery at night, seen straight down its length from the near end: a hushed, tense, elegant hall of cool silver moonlight, midnight blue and white marble, with small warm pools of gold light on the paintings.
keep: every wall edge, every tall arched window on the left wall, every gilt-framed portrait on the right wall and the two full-length portraits on the far wall, every marble statue on its plinth, the carpet runner from the far doors to the middle of the hall and the bare marble in front of it, the tall double doors at the far end, every floor joint and the horizon

floor.layout: a polished marble floor running straight away from the viewer, with the same grid as image 1.
floor.paint: The floor is polished dark grey marble in large square slabs with thin fine joints, one calm dim even tone. The whole near half of the floor, from the end of the carpet runner down to the bottom edge, is bare polished marble, plain, smooth and dark, open and clear for dancing, and only the far half carries a faint silver sheen of moonlight.

panel.layout: tall midnight-blue walls with gilded mouldings and a vaulted ceiling.
panel.paint: The walls are deep midnight-blue silk panels framed in thin gilt mouldings, under a deep gilded cornice and a dark barrel-vaulted ceiling.

door.layout: tall closed double doors at the far end.
door.paint: Tall closed double doors of dark wood with gilded panels stand at the far end of the gallery, the same width and height as in image 1 with their foot on the same line.

window.layout: tall arched windows along the left wall, full of moonlight.
window.paint: Tall arched windows along the left wall look out onto a dark night sky with a bright full moon, and cool silver moonlight falls through them onto the wall and the far floor.

glass.layout: gilt-framed oil portraits along the right wall, and two tall full-length portraits on the far wall either side of the doors.
glass.paint: Large old oil portraits of ladies and gentlemen in evening dress hang in heavy carved gilt frames along the right wall, and two tall full-length portraits on the far wall either side of the doors show a gentleman and a lady standing at full height, each painting lit from above by a small brass picture light casting a warm gold glow over it.

pilaster.layout: white marble statues on plinths standing against both walls.
pilaster.paint: White marble statues of classical figures and marble busts stand on tall plinths against both walls between the windows and the portraits, catching the silver moonlight.

stage.layout: a long carpet runner down the far half of the gallery.
stage.paint: A deep green carpet runner with a thin gold border lies on the marble from the foot of the far doors toward the viewer and ends in the middle of the hall, exactly where the rug ends in image 1, its square end resting on the bare marble.
